products.name: Car insurance
products.headline: Car insurance that keeps up with Indian roads
products.subhead: Chhatri Car Shield covers damage to your car, your legal liability to others, and you as the owner-driver, with add-ons you choose.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Cashless at network garages
highlights.text: Get repaired at a network garage and we settle the approved bill with the garage directly.

highlights.title: Add-ons you choose
highlights.text: Zero depreciation, engine protection, roadside assistance and more. Switch each one on or off and see the price change.

highlights.title: Your No Claim Bonus counts
highlights.text: Each claim-free year adds to your discount on the own-damage premium, up to 50%.

highlights.title: Help on the road
highlights.text: With roadside assistance, call us any time for towing, a jump-start, a tyre change or fuel delivery.

covered: Accidental damage, including collisions and damage while parked
Legal liability for injury to others or damage to their property
not_covered: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
Driving without a valid licence
Mechanical or electrical breakdown, and wear and tear
A damaged tyre on its own, without other damage to the car
Use as a taxi or for hire

addons.pa_owner: Pays ₹15,00,000 if the owner-driver dies or is permanently disabled in an accident involving the car. It is switched on by default.
addons.zero_dep: When parts are replaced, you are paid their full cost with no deduction for depreciation on plastic, rubber or metal. Available for cars up to 5 years old, for two claims a year.
addons.engine_protect: Covers damage to the engine and gearbox from water getting in, such as driving through a flooded road or starting a waterlogged car. Without it, this kind of engine damage is not covered.
addons.rsa: Call us at any hour if your car stops anywhere in India, for towing to a garage, a jump-start, a tyre change or emergency fuel. Parts and fuel are paid by you.
addons.return_to_invoice: If the car is stolen or written off, pays the gap between the IDV and the invoice price, including road tax and registration. Available for cars up to 3 years old.
addons.consumables: Pays for the nuts, bolts, engine oil, coolant, grease and similar items used in a covered repair, which are otherwise paid by you.
addons.key_replacement: Pays to replace lost, stolen or damaged car keys, and to change the locks if needed.
addons.ncb_protect: Lets you make a claim without losing your No Claim Bonus at renewal. Available when your NCB is 20% or more.

faqs.q: Is third-party cover included?
faqs.a: Yes. Third-party cover is compulsory in India, so every Chhatri Car Shield policy includes your legal liability for injury to others and damage to their property.

faqs.q: What is the IDV?
faqs.a: The Insured Declared Value is the most we pay if your car is stolen or written off. It is the ex-showroom price less depreciation for the car's age, and it is shown in your quote.

faqs.q: Will a claim affect my No Claim Bonus?
faqs.a: A claim resets your No Claim Bonus to zero at renewal, unless you have NCB protection. A claim only for broken glass does not affect it.

faqs.q: How soon must I report a claim?
faqs.a: Within 48 hours of the accident or loss, by calling the claims helpline or online. For theft, also file an FIR with the police straight away.

products.name: Two-wheeler insurance
products.headline: Cover for your scooter or motorcycle
products.subhead: Chhatri Bike Shield covers damage to your two-wheeler, your legal liability to others, and you as the owner-rider.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Own damage and third party
highlights.text: One policy for damage to your two-wheeler and your legal liability to others.

highlights.title: Owner-rider accident cover
highlights.text: ₹15,00,000 personal accident cover for you as the owner-rider, on by default.

highlights.title: Roadside help
highlights.text: Add roadside assistance for towing, puncture help or fuel if you are stuck.

highlights.title: No Claim Bonus
highlights.text: Each claim-free year adds to your discount on the own-damage premium.

covered: Legal liability for injury to others or damage to their property
not_covered: Riding under the influence of alcohol or drugs
Riding without a valid licence
Breakdown and wear and tear
A damaged tyre on its own
Use as a bike taxi or for deliveries

addons.pa_owner: Pays ₹15,00,000 if the owner-rider dies or is permanently disabled in an accident on the two-wheeler. It is switched on by default.
addons.zero_dep: Pays the full cost of replaced parts, with no deduction for depreciation. Available for two-wheelers up to 5 years old.
addons.engine_protect: Covers engine damage from water getting in, for example after riding through a flooded road.
addons.rsa: Call us if your two-wheeler stops anywhere in India, for towing, a puncture repair or emergency fuel. Fuel and parts are paid by you.
addons.consumables: Pays for engine oil, nuts, bolts, grease and similar items used in a covered repair.

faqs.q: Is my pillion rider covered?
faqs.a: Your legal liability for injury to a pillion rider is covered under third-party cover. Personal accident cover for the pillion is not part of the standard policy.

faqs.q: Can I use my scooter for deliveries?
faqs.a: No. The policy covers private use only. Damage while the two-wheeler is used as a bike taxi or for deliveries is not covered.

faqs.q: What happens if my two-wheeler is stolen?
faqs.a: File an FIR straight away and tell us within 48 hours. Once the police report it untraced, we pay the IDV less the deductible.

faqs.q: Is engine damage from rain water covered?
faqs.a: Only with the engine protection add-on. Without it, damage from water getting into the engine is not covered.

products.name: Health insurance
products.headline: Health cover for you, or your whole family
products.subhead: Chhatri Health Plus pays hospital bills for illness and injury, with cashless treatment at network hospitals.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Cashless at network hospitals
highlights.text: Show your health card at a network hospital and we settle the approved bill with the hospital.

highlights.title: Before and after hospital
highlights.text: Covers medical costs for 60 days before admission and 90 days after discharge, for the same illness.

highlights.title: Cover that grows
highlights.text: Each claim-free year adds a 10% cumulative bonus to your sum insured, up to 50%.

highlights.title: Individual or floater
highlights.text: Cover just yourself, or share one sum insured across your spouse and up to three children.

covered: Day care procedures such as dialysis and chemotherapy
Modern treatments such as robotic surgery, up to 50% of the sum insured
not_covered: Out-patient doctor visits and medicines, unless you add OPD cover
Maternity, unless you add maternity cover
Cosmetic surgery
Dental treatment, except after an accident
Non-medical items such as toiletries and attendant food

addons.room_rent_waiver: Removes the room rent limit, so you can choose any room category without your bill being cut in proportion.
addons.opd_cover: Pays up to ₹10,000 a year for doctor consultations, tests and medicines that do not need a hospital admission.
addons.maternity: Covers childbirth, including caesarean delivery, with pre- and post-natal care. Available on a family floater with two adults, where the eldest adult is 45 or younger.
addons.critical_illness: Pays a lump sum of ₹5,00,000 to each covered adult on diagnosis of a listed critical illness, in addition to hospital bills.

faqs.q: What are the waiting periods?
faqs.a: Illnesses in the first 30 days are not covered, except accidents. Listed conditions such as cataract, hernia and kidney stones are covered after 24 months, and declared pre-existing diseases after 36 months of continuous cover.

faqs.q: Is there a room rent limit?
faqs.a: Yes. Room rent is covered up to 1% of the sum insured per day and ICU up to 2%. If you choose a costlier room, most of the bill is paid in proportion, unless you add the room rent limit waiver.

faqs.q: Do I have to pay GST on the premium?
faqs.a: No. Individual health insurance premiums are exempt from GST.

faqs.q: How do I claim?
faqs.a: At a network hospital, show your health card for cashless treatment. Elsewhere, pay the hospital and send us the claim within 30 days of discharge.

products.name: Term life insurance
products.headline: Life cover that protects your family's future
products.subhead: Chhatri Term Secure pays a lump sum to your nominee if you die during the policy term, for a premium that stays the same every year.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Fixed premium
highlights.text: Your premium is set when you buy and does not rise with age during the term.

highlights.title: Optional riders
highlights.text: Add accidental death benefit, a critical illness rider or waiver of premium on disability.

highlights.title: No GST
highlights.text: Individual life insurance premiums are exempt from GST.

covered: Death from any cause during the policy term
Lump sum paid to your nominee
Extra payout for accidental death, with the rider
Lump sum on a listed critical illness, with the rider
Future premiums waived on disability, with the rider
30-day grace period to pay each premium
not_covered: Suicide in the first 12 months (80% of premiums paid are returned)
Survival to the end of the term: no maturity benefit
Accidental death benefit when the death is due to alcohol or drugs
Accidental death benefit for hazardous sports or war
Any surrender value

addons.accidental_death: Pays an extra ₹25,00,000 to your nominee if death is caused by an accident, on top of the life cover.
addons.critical_illness_rider: Pays ₹10,00,000 on diagnosis of a listed critical illness, such as certain cancers or a heart attack.
addons.waiver_of_premium: If you become permanently disabled, your future premiums are waived and the cover continues.

faqs.q: Does the premium go up as I get older?
faqs.a: No. The premium is fixed when the policy starts and stays the same for the whole term.

faqs.q: Do I get anything back if I outlive the term?
faqs.a: No. Chhatri Term Secure is pure protection, so nothing is paid at the end of the term.

faqs.q: What if I miss a premium?
faqs.a: You have a 30-day grace period and stay covered during it. After that the policy lapses, and you can revive it within 5 years.

faqs.q: How long must the cover run?
faqs.a: At least 10 years. You choose cover until age 60, 65, 70 or 75.

products.name: Home insurance
products.headline: Protect your home and everything in it
products.subhead: Chhatri Ghar Suraksha covers the structure of your home and your belongings against fire, flood, burglary and more.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Building and contents
highlights.text: Cover the rebuilding cost of your home, your belongings, or both. Tenants can cover contents alone.

highlights.title: Natural calamities
highlights.text: Storm, cyclone, flood and landslide are covered, with earthquake as an add-on.

highlights.title: Burglary
highlights.text: Theft after a break-in is covered, along with damage to doors and windows.

highlights.title: A discount for security
highlights.text: Homes with a security system or a guarded gate get a discount on the premium.

covered: Fire, including short circuits and gas cylinder blasts
Bursting or overflowing water tanks and pipes
not_covered: Theft without signs of forced entry
Wear and tear, damp and slow leaks
Breakdown of appliances and electronics
Jewellery and gold, unless you add valuables cover
Cash and documents

addons.earthquake: Covers damage to the structure and your belongings from an earthquake. Needs building cover.
addons.valuables: Covers jewellery, gold, watches and other valuables up to ₹2,00,000.
addons.electronics: Covers accidental damage to or loss of laptops, phones, tablets and cameras anywhere in India, up to ₹1,50,000.
addons.rent_loss: For owners: pays lost rent or alternative accommodation while the home is repaired after insured damage. Not available to tenants.
addons.public_liability: Covers your legal liability, up to ₹10,00,000, for injury to others or damage to their property caused from your home, such as a leak into the flat below.

faqs.q: Can I insure my home if I rent it?
faqs.a: Yes. Tenants can cover their household contents. The building is insured by its owner.

faqs.q: Is theft covered?
faqs.a: Theft is covered when there is forced entry into your home. Items that simply go missing are not covered.

faqs.q: What if my home is empty for a long time?
faqs.a: If it is unoccupied for more than 60 days in a row, tell us first. Otherwise cover for burglary, vandalism and burst pipes stops after 60 days.

faqs.q: Is my laptop covered for a fall?
faqs.a: With the portable electronics add-on, accidental damage is covered. A laptop that simply stops working is not.

products.name: Travel insurance
products.headline: Travel abroad with cover for the unexpected
products.subhead: Chhatri Travel covers medical emergencies abroad, flight delays, lost baggage and lost passports, for every traveller on your trip.
products.starting_from_note: See your price in under a minute

highlights.title: Medical cover abroad
highlights.text: Essential covers emergency medical costs up to US$50,000 per traveller; Plus covers up to US$1,00,000.

highlights.title: Delays and baggage
highlights.text: Get paid for long flight delays, delayed bags and lost checked-in baggage.

highlights.title: Help at any hour
highlights.text: Call our assistance service in an emergency and we will guide you to a hospital and try to arrange cashless treatment.

highlights.title: Family and group trips
highlights.text: Cover up to six travellers on one policy, with a discount for three or more.

covered: Emergency medical treatment and hospitalisation abroad
Flight delay of more than 6 hours
Baggage delayed by more than 12 hours
not_covered: Pre-existing illness, except a life-threatening emergency
Anything caused by alcohol or drugs
Adventure sports, unless you add adventure sports cover
Travelling against medical advice
Cancelling for a change of plans

addons.trip_cancellation: Pays your non-refundable bookings if you must cancel before leaving for a listed reason, such as a death or hospitalisation in the family, serious damage at home, or a visa refusal.
addons.baggage_plus: Raises your baggage cover and adds cover for hand baggage, laptops and cameras.
addons.adventure_sports: Covers medical costs from activities such as scuba diving, bungee jumping, paragliding and rafting.

faqs.q: When does my cover start?
faqs.a: Medical and travel cover starts when you board your flight from India and ends when you return. Trip cancellation cover applies from purchase until you leave.

faqs.q: Is my existing illness covered abroad?
faqs.a: Only for a sudden, life-threatening emergency arising from it during the trip. Routine treatment is not covered.

faqs.q: How does flight delay cover work?
faqs.a: If your flight is delayed by more than 6 hours, you get ₹1,000 for every full 6 hours of delay, up to the limit in your policy. Keep the airline's letter confirming the delay.

faqs.q: What should I do in a medical emergency?
faqs.a: Call the assistance service on the claims helpline before or within 24 hours of admission. We will try to pay the hospital directly.
